parameter.name: CFPCOLS
parameter.comment: The columns of the crowded-field photometry file that contain: ID, x position, y position and magnitude of the stars
parameter.updated: Appended parameter CFPCOLS to configuration file.

parameter.name: PASSBAND
parameter.comment: The photometric passband in which the provided magnitudes are given
parameter.updated: Appended parameter PASSBAND to configuration file.

parameter.name: PIXSCALE
parameter.comment: The scaling of the IFU pixels with respect to the input coordinates. Same as the IFU pixelsize if the input coordinates are given in acrseconds. If the input coordinates are given in pixels, it is the ratio of IFU to input pixelsize.
parameter.updated: Appended parameter PIXSCALE to configuration file.

parameter.name: APERRAD
parameter.comment: Radius (in spaxels) used for aperture spectrophotometry
parameter.updated: Appended parameter APERRAD to configuration file.

parameter.name: APERNOIS
parameter.comment: The maximum allowed fraction of contaminating flux within APERRAD. Aperture spectrophotometry is performed only for sources whose nearby neighbors contribute less than APERNOIS to the measured flux.
parameter.updated: Appended parameter APERNOIS to configuration file.

parameter.name: RESLIM
parameter.comment: The magnitude down to which stars can possibly be resolved in the datacube.
parameter.updated: Appended parameter RESLIM to configuration file.

parameter.name: SNRCUT
parameter.comment: The cut in expected Signal-to-Noise below which no sources are selected. The Signal-to-Noise is determined from the estimated FWHM and the results of the aperture spectrophotometry .
parameter.updated: Appended parameter SNRCUT to configuration file.

parameter.name: BINRAD
parameter.comment: The minimum spatial separation [measured in units of the expected FWHM] of two resolved sources. Resolved sources with distances smaller BINRAD are combined.
parameter.updated: Appended parameter BINRAD to configuration file.

parameter.name: GLOBSKY
parameter.comment: Flag determines whether a global sky background (i.e a component with constant surface brightness over the FoV) is included in the fit
parameter.updated: Appended parameter GLOBSKY to configuration file.

parameter.name: USEUNRES
parameter.comment: Flag indicates whether the contribution from the unresolved sources should be included as an additional component in the analysis.
parameter.updated: Appended parameter USEUNRES to configuration file.

parameter.name: UNRESLIM
parameter.comment: Only has an effect if USEUNRES is enabled. In that case the contribution from the unresolved sources is estimated only for sources with magnitudes brighter than UNRESLIM.
parameter.updated: Appended parameter UNRESLIM to configuration file.

parameter.name: EWIDTH
parameter.comment: Only has an effect if USEUNRES is enabled. In that case, EWIDTH specifies the maximum distance of a considered source outside the FoV to the edge of the FoV [in spaxels].
parameter.updated: Appended parameter EWIDTH to configuration file.

parameter.name: SMALLIFU
parameter.comment: This flag defines how the determination of the PSF and the coordinate transformation is performed during the fit. If SMALLIFU is enabled, all sources are used for this purpose (recommended for IFUs with a small number of spatial pixels), otherwise bright, isolated stars are used (recommended for MUSE)
parameter.updated: Appended parameter SMALLIFU to configuration file.

parameter.name: DOBACKUP
parameter.comment: If DOBACKUP-flag is set, input values will not be deleted but moved to backup-HDUs in the PRM-file
parameter.updated: Appended parameter DOBACKUP to configuration file.

parameter.name: STORERES
parameter.comment: If the STORERES-flag is set, a datacube with the residuals of the fit will be stored.
parameter.updated: Appended parameter STORERES to configuration file.

parameter.name: FITRAD
parameter.comment: The fitting radius (given in spatial pixels) defines the circular area around a source used in the PSF fit of that source
parameter.updated: Appended parameter FITRAD to configuration file.

parameter.name: PSFRAD
parameter.comment: The radius out to which the PSF of a source will be defined. Should be large enough to avoid annuli of flux around the brighter sources in the residuals
parameter.updated: Appended parameter PSFRAD to configuration file.

parameter.name: POSFIT
parameter.comment: Defines how source positions are handled in the fit:
0 - Sources are fixed to their input positions.
1 - Only a global offset is fitted.
2 - A global offset and scaling are fitted.
3 - Individual positions are fitted.
parameter.updated: Appended parameter POSFIT to configuration file.

parameter.name: PSFTYPE
parameter.comment: The analytical profile that is used to model the PSF.
parameter.updated: Appended parameter PSFTYPE to configuration file.

parameter.name: PSFPARS
parameter.comment: The initial values of the PSF shape parameters. The meaning of the parameters for the individual profiles can be found in the manual.
parameter.updated: Appended parameter PSFPARS to configuration file.

parameter.name: PSFFIT
parameter.comment: The degree of PSF variablility, given as SUM(2**N), with N being the position in the PSFPARS array (starting with 1) of a PSF shape parameter that should be fitted
parameter.updated: Appended parameter PSFFIT to configuration file.

parameter.name: VERBOSE
parameter.comment: The chattiness of PampelMuse, i.e. the amount of information that is printed out
parameter.updated: Appended parameter VERBOSE to configuration file.

parameter.name: JUMPSTART
parameter.comment: Flag indicates whether the fit starts directly or after presseing the START-button
parameter.updated: Appended parameter JUMPSTART to configuration file.
